name: MALAKSHMI BORTHAKUR

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Malakshmi Borthakur writes poetry in Assamese, Hindi and English, alongside short fiction and translation. Her literary biographies connect her roots in Jorhat, Assam, with years in Lucknow, and record studies in English literature and Indian classical vocal music. Her English collection Splendid Signature: Rhythmic Strokes of a Quill was published by Black Eagle Books.

In The Caravan of Life, her Kabita Live contribution, feelings struggle to find speech beneath the weight of ego. A heart is left merely to beat, sorrow wears the appearance of happiness, and tears finally escape through smudged kajal. The repeated onward movement of the caravan holds endurance and disappointment together: life continues, but so does the longing for a little happiness.
